synopsis: After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she’s not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family’s province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King may be defeated, but his allies and demons continue to roam. With only her wits and brilliance, Rome will build an army of her own and keep the kingdom safe—no matter what it takes. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synopsis: Riding in a camper, eating delicious food, and enjoying the spectacular view. Saori Furuki was a university student in the engineering department and loved making things. After a car accident, she is reborn as Eline, the daughter of a viscount, However, her family treats her coldly, saying that she is incompetent and can only use magic to produce items, and she is exiled from the country. However, Eline's “alchemy magic” is a magic that has unlimited possibilities when combined with the knowledge from her previous life! Determined to live freely from now on, Eline has created a camper for starters. She can move around, live, and make things as she pleases. Together with Aristy, a martial maid who adores Eline, she begins her adventurous journey with a sense of ease. Eating delicious food, admiring the spectacular scenery, and creating useful things. This is a travel story about riding in a camper and enjoying another world with elegance. (Source: SB Creative, translated)

title: Sherlock + Academy
titleNative: シャーロック＋アカデミー
synopsis: The need for detectives has dramatically increased in response to the increasing number of violent crimes. This year, a boy and a girl enter Marimine Detective Academy, an ultra-exclusive school, and the only one in Japan that offers the "National Detective License." The boy is Misaki Fujisaki, the grandson of the man who was once known as the "Crime King." The girl is Shia E. Hazeldine, the adopted daughter of the man known as the "Detective King." These two descendants of sworn enemies will meet each other by chance! And as their school days begin, an incident occurs right from the entrance ceremony!? Moreover, for some reason, Fujisaki's score is higher than Shia's, even though she supposedly solved the mystery first... "I challenge you!" "Don't regret this, princess." This is a unique academy story where students compete to find the truth. This is intellectual excitement at its highest peak! (Source: MFBunko J, translated)
